# git.agentic

> Open-source infrastructure for software built and operated by AI agents.

git.agentic is an open-source suite led by Toni Bergholm. The flagship
project versions the six dimensions that determine AI agent behavior—code,
prompts, tools, model, memory, and schema—and can roll them back coherently.
The suite also includes src-control for parallel in-memory agent worktrees,
encrypted collaboration, Git interoperability, and native desktop repository
browsing, plus Sentinel for agent-auditable npm supply-chain security.

## Products

- [git.agentic](https://git-agentic.com/git-agentic): Version control and atomic rollback for AI agent behavior.
- [src-control](https://git-agentic.com/src-control): Version control for parallel AI agents with in-memory worktrees, encrypted paths and branches, signed provenance, Git sync, and a native read-only desktop browser.
- [Sentinel](https://git-agentic.com/sentinel): An auditing security layer and registry for npm used by agents.
